BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY CODNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the M3-3 Heavy Industry District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 5-H in the area bounded by


           West Fullerton Avenue; a line 100 feet cast of and parallel to North Sccley
           Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue; and
           North Seeley Avenue,


to those of a C2-3 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and approval.




Common Address of Property:         2023 W Fullerton Ave, Chicago, IL 60647
                                  Project Narrative And Plans
                              Type 1 Rezoning Map Amendment
                               Zoning District from M3-3 to C2-3
                            2023 W Fullerton Ave, Chicago, IL 60647




The project
To change the zoning district from M3-3 to C2-3, seeking a Type 1 zoning map amendment for
the remodeling of the existing one-story brick building to contain:
    •   Commercial space on the ground floor to establish a Cannabis Business Establishment
        use



The site
The 12,500 square foot site (a parcel approximately 100 feet (frontage) x 125 feet) is located at
2023 W Fullerton Ave, Chicago, IL 60647. The subject property is improved with a one-story
building containing approximately 9,679 square feet of floor area plus approximately 2,821
square feet for parking. The land uses in the immediate vicinity of the subject property consist
of a residential multi-unit across the public alley to the South; a residential multi-unit across
Seeley Avenue to the West; a Waterway-Business Planned Development (tennis club) across
Fullerton Avenue to the North; and a commercial brick building immediately to the East.

The following are the relevant bulk calculations for the project narrative:

Proposed land use: Cannabis retail establishment

Floor area ratio: 0.75   (no change)

Lot area per dwelling: N/A (no change)

Off-street parking: 4 spaces

Setbacks: front = 0 (none required, no change)
          rear = 0 (none required, no change)
          side/West = 0 (none required, no change)
          side/East = 0 (rione required, no change)

Building Fleight: one-story, approximately 15 feet (no change)
